view.name: Sample grid
view.description: Main dataset workspace: sidebar of field filters (tags, metadata, labels, primitives) next to a grid of image samples with detection box overlays, plus a view bar and toolbar.

regions.label: App top bar: FiftyOne logo/title, 'Select dataset' combobox, Upgrade pill, light-mode toggle, Discord/GitHub/Docs icon links
'No dataset selected' heading, an explanation, and a 'Did you know?' tip with plugin and browse-operations links
'Select a dataset with code' heading and subtitle, a 'Python' tab strip, and a 12-line syntax-highlighted Python snippet with line numbers and a Copy button

evidence.note: Explanation of the empty view, plus a 'Did you know?' tip
Sample code offered as a second way out of the empty state
Persistent top bar with identity, dataset switcher and utility links
role=tablist with one selected tab, shown by an orange underline indicator; only one language tab exists

patterns.rationale: The dataset selector is exposed as role=combobox with the placeholder 'Select dataset'. Its suggestion list is not visible in the capture, and on the live page clicking it navigated straight into a dataset, so the suggestion behaviour could not be verified.

evidence.note: Combobox input for choosing a dataset
Code is read-only sample text with a Copy button, not an editing surface
There is only a global Documentation icon link; the empty-state tip is already counted under empty-state

structure.layout: Full-width app with a dark top bar (logo, dataset selector combobox, utility icon links). The content area below is a centred empty state: a message block, a hairline divider, then a 'Select a dataset with code' block with a single language tab and a read-only Python snippet

aesthetics.typography: Palanquin (a humanist sans) for all UI text: title, body, tabs and links. Roboto Mono for the code snippet.
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast in size. Brand title 23px/400; section headings 16px/400 in white; body and help text 14px in grey #b3b3b3; Upgrade pill 12px; code 14px mono. Hierarchy comes mostly from colour (white vs grey) rather than weight.

notes: Dark FiftyOne App landing with no dataset loaded. Near-black #1a1a1a canvas and a slightly lighter #262626 header. Voxel51 orange #ff6d05 is used sparingly: the logo and the active-tab label and underline. The code block uses a Monokai-like token palette (#f8f8f2 text, #d4d0ab comments, #abe338 strings). The Upgrade link is a pill with a thin #2f3234 border; the header icons are circular ghost buttons. A full-width hairline divider separates the empty message from the code section. The live page is in a shared session and opened a dataset view (sidebar filters, sample grid, Model Evaluation panel) after clicking the selector, but the capture shows only the empty state. I filed a new-entry proposal 'code-snippet' for the copyable, read-only code block.
